descriptive_comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive only; no confirmatory superiority hypothesis was preregistered.

precision_contract.interpretation: The frozen Phase-1 target is intentionally coarser than the illustrative project-document example and is not equivalent to ±1 BB/100 precision.

scope_limitations: The experiment is a scoped Phase-1 static-profile baseline measurement, not the complete D_test population benchmark.
Only five frozen static opponent profiles are represented; lower-tail population quantities such as R10 have a five-profile tail-precision warning.
The nested population bootstrap reflects profile-level uncertainty and is much wider than the fixed-profile precision interval.
The hand-strength fixed-profile half-width exceeded the frozen ±50 BB/100 target; no additional hands were added after observing the result.
Pilot observations were excluded from final estimates.
